question: In January 2022, Paytm Money launched India’s first intelligent messenger called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pops**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pops** is the name of India's first intelligent messenger launched by Paytm Money in January 2022.
 
• This innovative feature aims to provide users with personalized updates, insights, and important information related to their investments.
 
• The messenger is designed to enhance the user experience by offering timely and relevant notifications dire
